title.narrative: SDG & SMART CITIES IN MADINAH REGION

description.narrative: Madinah region in Saudi Arabia has recently undergone massive urban developments led by the Madinah Development Authority with the vision of making the region tranquil and dynamic. The region is known for its strategic position and being the host of millions of visitors every year. It is also the fourth-most populous city in the country and is generally considered to be the "cradle of Islamic culture and civilization". Recently, a smart city strategy was approved to guide the design and implementation of technology initiatives in the region. The smart city strategy commits MDA to put technology, innovation and collaboration at the heart of the Madinah city with the goal of delivering enriched experiences to residents and visitors. it is people-centric and demand driven. Al Madinah Smart City focuses on six prioritized sectors: wellbeing, tourism, environment, mobility, business, and old neighborhoods. To enable the impact of Madinah Smart City in these sectors, the city will engage with the programme ecosystem, which includes Smart City Supply, Digital Society Enablement, Smart City Platform, and Smart City Enablers. The sectors overview and the implementation of 56 use cases across prioritized sectors will also be provided to identify key challenges, implementation considerations, use case journey and examples from around the world. MDA is also pioneering efforts to achieve the global sustainable development goals (SDGs) in the Madinah region. It has signed a letter of intent with UN-Habitat to join the SDG Cities Global Initiative and committed to becoming an inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable city. By joining the SDG cities global initiative, MDA will be able to obtain required certification of SDG Cities and will be able to build their capacity to localize SDGs. The SDG and Smart city initiatives led by MDA align very well to UN-Habitat’s work and the global normative frameworks for sustainable urbanization. The project seeks to foster collaboration between MDA and UN-Habitat to realize the vision of Madinah region (tranquil and dynamic smart city) and to support MDA in the execution of specific SDG and Smart city initiatives. MDA will benefit from UN-Habitat People-centered Smart Cities and SDG Cities flagship programme approaches andframeworks. The overall objective of the project is to support Madinah Development Authority in reaching its SDG targets and adopting a people-centered smart city approach to become a tranquil, and dynamic smart city, delivering enriched experiences to its residents and visitors, by putting technology, innovation, and collaboration at the heart of Madinah City”. A two-phased approach will be employed to produce the normative outputs and implement the other project activities. The project will have the following four outcomes: 1. Al-Madinah city has a comprehensive, evidence-based development strategy for 2030 that sets out how it will achieve the SDGs and reach its vision. 2. Local Institutions in Al Madinah are fit-for-purpose to achieve a human-centered, resilient, smart, sustainable city. 3. Madinah attracts investment needed to become a human-centered, resilient, smart, sustainable city. 4. Madinah is presented as a case study of a human-centered, resilient, smart and sustainable city in international fora. The project will coordinate with UN Regional Coordinator’s office through UN-Habitat Regional Office and United Nations Economic and Social Commission for West Asia (ESCWA)
